_help.whatThisFileIs: The list of accounts that may open the hidden staff release editor (Left Alt + F2). It is a plain public file, so it must never contain passwords, tokens, email addresses, or anything private. Only public profile details belong here.
_help.whatItIsNot: This is not a login service. The site has no backend and does not contact Discord, so an entry here cannot prove who someone is. It is an allowlist that keeps the panel out of casual hands, nothing more. Never put anything confidential behind it: the editor only changes what one browser displays.

fields.username: Discord username, without the @. Matched case-insensitively. Required unless you only use userId.
fields.displayName: Optional. The name shown in the editor once signed in.
fields.userId: Optional. Discord user ID (the long number). Also accepted at sign-in, and useful when someone renames.
fields.role: Optional label such as owner or editor. Shown in the editor only.
fields.enabled: Optional. Set to false to keep an account in the list but block it.
fields.codeHash: Optional. Lowercase hex SHA-256 of a staff code. Leave it as an empty string to allow the account on its name alone.

howToAddAnAccount: 1. Open this file in any text editor.
2. Copy the example block below, including the braces, and paste it after the last account inside the "accounts" square brackets.
3. Put a comma after the closing brace of the account that came before it.
4. Fill in your Discord username, display name, and user ID. Only public details.
5. Save the file and upload it to the repository at assets/data/staff.json.
6. Press Left Alt + F2 on any page and sign in with that username or user ID.
howToSetAStaffCode: 1. Open the site, press Left Alt + F2, and sign in to the editor.
2. In the editor, open "Staff code hash" and type the code you want to use.
4. Paste it into that account's codeHash field in this file, in quotes, and upload the file.
5. From then on that account must also enter the code. A long, unique code is the only kind worth using, because this file is public and the hash can be attacked offline.
_help.beforeYouPublish: Replace or remove the placeholder account below. Leaving a name-only account enabled means anyone who reads this file can open the editor.
